title: an alias body keeps its members after a fault
note: FOUND 2026-09-03, FIXED the same day. An `alias b for a { … }` body is mapped under a Membership, and re-homing excluded relationships from the OPENER set as well as from the candidates — so the body had no opener and its members were re-homed onto the previous sibling instead (`w` landed inside `part a`). Compare with the same file written without the fault: containment must be identical.
